title: The Eleventh HOPE (2016): Coding by Voice with Open Source Speech Recognition
summary: A HOPE XI talk on programming by voice with open source speech recognition. The speaker writes Linux systems code by voice and describes building custom voice grammars as an alternative to the keyboard for programmers with repetitive strain injuries.
why: HN cites it as proof that voice coding works and lists it among resources for programmers who can't type.
